articles.summary: “It’s ongoing. It’s always in my head. I probably think about PKU most of my waking hours.” A person living with PKU is describing something that many people with phenylketonuria (PKU), a rare, inherited metabolic condition, understand all too well: the condition doesn’t ‘clock off.’ As people with PKU, families, patient advocates, healthcare professionals, researchers…
articles.title: E.S.PKU Conference 2026: Listening to the Experiences of People Living with PKU
